description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为**50**，默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page during paging. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
要查询的路由表所属的VPC的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh: 要查询的路由表所属资源组的ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the route table belongs.

description.zh:
要查询的路由表的ID。

>**VRouterId**，**RouteTableId**，**RouterId**和**RouteTableName**参数至少需要输入一个，但是不能同时输入**VRouterId**和**RouterId**参数。
description.en:
The ID of the route table to query.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: VRouterId, RouteTableId, RouterId, and RouteTableName. You cannot specify both VRouterId and RouterId at the same time.

description.zh:
要查询的路由表的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

>**VRouterId**，**RouteTableId**，**RouterId**和**RouteTableName**参数至少需要输入一个，但是不能同时输入**VRouterId**和**RouterId**参数。
description.en:
The name of the route table to query.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: VRouterId, RouteTableId, RouterId, and RouteTableName. You cannot specify both VRouterId and RouterId at the same time.

description.zh:
要查询的路由表所属路由器的ID。

>**VRouterId**，**RouteTableId**，**RouterId**和**RouteTableName**参数至少需要输入一个，但是不能同时输入**VRouterId**和**RouterId**参数。
description.en:
The ID of the router to which the route table belongs.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: VRouterId, RouteTableId, RouterId, and RouteTableName. You cannot specify both VRouterId and RouterId at the same time.

description.zh:
要查询的路由表所属的路由器的类型。取值：

- **VRouter**（默认值）：VPC路由器。
- **VBR**：边界路由器。
description.en:
The type of the router to which the route table belongs. Valid values:

- **VRouter** (default): vRouter.
- **VBR**: Virtual Border Router.

description.zh:
要查询的路由条目的类型。取值：

- **Custom**：自定义路由。
- **System**：系统路由。
- **BGP**：BGP路由。
- **CEN**：云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）路由。
- **ECR**：专线网关路由。
description.en:
The destination type of the route to query. Valid values:

- **Custom**: custom route.
- **System**: system route.
- **BGP**: BGP route.
- **CEN**: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR) route.

description.zh:
要查询的路由器的ID。

>**VRouterId**，**RouteTableId**，**RouterId**和**RouteTableName**参数至少需要输入一个，但是不能同时输入**VRouterId**和**RouterId**参数。
description.en:
The ID of the vRouter to query.

>You must specify at least one of the following parameters: VRouterId, RouteTableId, RouterId, and RouteTableName. You cannot specify both VRouterId and RouterId at the same time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-route-tables --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vrouter-id vrt-bp1lhl0taikrteen0000 --route-table-id vtb-bp145q7glnuzdvzu20000 --router-type VRouter --router-id vrt-bp1lhl0taikrteen80000 --type Custom --route-table-name doctest --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeRouteTables --region cn-hangzhou --VRouterId 'vrt-bp1lhl0taikrteen0000' --Type Custom --RouteTableId 'vtb-bp145q7glnuzdvzu20000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph0000' --PageSize 10 --RouterType VRouter --PageNumber 1 --RouterId 'vrt-bp1lhl0taikrteen80000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --RouteTableName doctest
